content: Abhasakirya muhuungati bharasorwa

Kuziisiku ziyo, abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhakabha bharaaruha. Gati waabhu, bhaabharimu Abhayahudi bhano bhahaakeerenia ekigaambo kye Ekiyunaani, na Abhayahudi abharikyaabhu bhano bhahaakeerenia ekigaambo kye Ekiaramu.
Bharya bhahaakeerenia Ekiyunaani bhakaririirira kubha, abhatuumba bhaabhu bhareebhwa eriibhaga rye esoondo ye ebhyaakurya bhye eziisiku zyoosi.
Kweego, abheega ikumi na bhabhiri bharya bhakasaanga na abhaanabheega bhoosi no okubhabhuurira, “Etari kisi, etwe tutige okweegya engʼana ya Taatabhugya, kwiiguru yo okusoondera abhaatu ebhyaakurya.
Kweego abhahiiri bheetu, musore abhasubhe muhuungati gati weenyu bhano bhiizuriibhwe ne Ekoro Muhoreeru na amangʼeeni, okubha tubhatuure kumirimo gino.
Neetwe turiiruusya kwo okumusabha Taatabhugya no okweegya abhaatu engʼana yaaye.”

Gano bhaagaambiri, gakabhazomera abhaatu bhoosi. Neebho bhakasora Sitefano, omuutu wuno yiizwiiri Ekoro Muhoreeru na mweene obhwiikirirya bhukuru, na bhakabhasora Firipo, Porokoro, Nikanori, Timoni, Parimena na Nikorao wa Antiokia,
wuno yarwiiri mukyaaro ekiindi akiikirirya enyaangi ye Ekiyahudi.
Niho okumara bhakabhareeta abhaatu bhayo embere wa abheega. Abheega bhakabhatuurira amabhoko iguru waabhu no okubhasabhira.
Eriingʼana rya Taatabhugya rikageenderera kunyaragana kubhaatu. No obhwaaru bhwa abhaanabheega bhukabha bhuraaruha Yerusaremu, naabhe abhaseengeri bhaaru bhakamwiikirirya Yeesu.
Sitefano aragwaatwa
Sitefano wuyo, eno yiizwiiri orubhaango runo yaheerwe na Taatabhugya, yaari no obhunagya bhwaaru, neewe ahaakora ebhyeerekenio ne ebhiruguuro gatigati wa abhaatu.
Nawe Abhayahudi abharebhe bhaari bharasakya kuhakana na Sitefano. Abhaatu bhayo bhaari bha munyuumba ye esaango
yino yeekubhirikirwa Enyuumba ye Esaango ya Abhaatu Bhano Bhano Obhwiiragaanzi, nabho bhakarweera Kirene, Arekizandiria, Kirikia na Asia.
Nawe bhataanagirye kumuhiza, kwe ekigirirye kya amangʼeeni na akagaamba kwo okukaangatwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru.
Niho bhakagaambana na abhaatu abhaandi kwo okubhaha ehoongo, okubha bhagaambe orurimi kubha bhamwiigwiiri Sitefano aragaamba amabhi go okumutuka Musa na Taatabhugya.
Kwo okugaamba ego, bhakabhasiigirirya abhaatu, abhakaruka bha Abhayahudi na abheegya bhe emigiro.
Neebho bhakamugwaata Sitefano no okumuhira mukiina kya abhakuru bha Abhayahudi.

Okumara bhaareetiri abhamenyeekererya bho orurimi bhano bhaagaambiri orurimi bhakubhuga, “Omuutu wuno atakurosa no okutiga kugaamba amangʼana amabhi go okutuka eriiseengerero eriihoreeru rino, na iguru ye emigiro gya Musa!
Tumwiigwiiri arabhuga Yeesu Omunazareeti arahasarya ahagiro he eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya, na arakyoosya eziinyaangi zoosi zino twabhweeni kurwa ku Musa.”
Abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhaari bhiikeeri mukiina kiyo bhakamumogorera Sitefano, bhakarora obhusyo bhwaaye bhuramesya kyo obhusyo bhwa maraika.

footnotes.text: Mu Yerusaremu, kwaari no obhwiisaangino bhwa Abhayahudi. Abhaandi simuka yaabhu yaari ebhyaaro ebhiindi, etari Iziraeri, na bhayo bhahaakeerenia Ekiyunaani. Abhayahudi bha Yudea na Yerusaremu bhaari bharakeerenia ekigaambo kyaabhu kye Ekiaramu.
Firipo, Porokoro, Nikanori, Timoni, Parimena na Nikorao wa Antiokia, amariina ga abhaatu bhoosi bhano ni ge Ekiyunaani. Kweego gareerekya kubha abhaatu bhayo bhaari bhe esaango ye Ekiyunaani.
Enyuumba ye esaango yaari nyuumba yo okwiikumania Abhayahudi kwiiguru yo okumuseengera Taatabhugya, eheene kurusiku rwo okumuunya. Rora amangʼana gano mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Abheegya bhe emigiro. Rora abheegya mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
